title: Mostantól: Committing to a New Habit

sections.title: Reusing -tól/-től for a fresh start
sections.content: You already know mostantól ("from now on") from -tól/-től Beyond the Clock. It's the natural word for wrapping up a plan to live more healthily: put it at the front of a sentence, keep the verb in the present tense the same way you already do for near-future plans, and add fokozatosan ("gradually") if the change won't happen all at once.

items.english: From now on I'm living more healthily.
From now on I'm gradually changing my habits.

items.spanish: Az a célom, hogy jobban aludjak.
items.english: My goal is to sleep better.

sections.content: Az a célom, hogy... ("My goal is that...") reuses the same hogy + imperative pattern you just used for advice in azt javaslom, hogy... — here it's your own goal instead of advice to someone else.
